evidence.description: Incident report 23-098993 states the date of incident as Wednesday, July 26, 2023, and the location as the 12000 block of South I-10 Service Road, New Orleans, LA, a commercial premises.
A patrol unit responded to a reported burglary at the commercial premises. Examination of the point of entry showed the perpetrators forced entry, which police class as a burglary.
Vehicle information recorded as a white Nissan Xterra SUV. The report does not state how the vehicle is linked to the incident.
Items missing recorded as not reported.
